summary: Assistant Technical Project Manager with 10+ years of full-lifecycle web engineering and experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams. Skilled in software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/Scrum delivery, project scope and milestone planning, sprint planning, backlog management, resource allocation, stakeholder communication, and quality assurance. Combines hands-on WordPress, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML and CSS expertise with technical SEO, performance optimization, and analytics reporting. Holds a postgraduate Data Science certification, with foundational Python and machine learning knowledge. Connects client business goals with technical execution to support timely, quality-focused web delivery.
